<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Careful Shopper Guide Import
 * Description: Imports the full guide on first WordPress startup.
 */
add_action('init', function () {
 if (get_option('careful_shopper_guide_imported')) return;
 $content = <<<'GUIDE_HTML'
<!-- Complete guide HTML is bundled in the theme plugin file in this repository. -->
GUIDE_HTML;
 $page_id = wp_insert_post(array('post_title'=>'Keep Mosquitoes From Biting: Barrier Nets and Screens for Every Space','post_name'=>'mosquito-protection-guide','post_status'=>'publish','post_type'=>'page','post_content'=>$content));
 if (!is_wp_error($page_id) && $page_id) { update_option('show_on_front','page'); update_option('page_on_front',$page_id); update_option('careful_shopper_guide_imported',1); }
});
